title: Perplexity AI Makes Waves with New Sonar API for Enterprise AI Search
summary: Perplexity AI has unveiled Sonar, an innovative API service that allows businesses to seamlessly integrate AI search technology into their applications. The Sonar API comes in two tiers: a Standard version that offers a cost-effective solution for basic needs, and Sonar Pro, which provides advanced features, including multi-step query handling and enhanced compliance capabilities. Sonar sets itself apart with real-time web searches and verifiable citations, targeting industries like finance, healthcare, and IT services. This marks a significant move in the AI search market, posing a challenge to established giants like Google and signaling a shift towards more accessible AI technologies for smaller businesses.
